newsitem.title: GERMANY: Schering boosted by large order - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Schering boosted by large order - dealers.

text.p: Shares in German drugs manufacturer Schering AG climbed over four percent on Wednesday, with dealers saying one large buy order was boosting the stock and technical factors were also supportive.
"There is one large buy order from one bank and technically Schering also looks very good," said one trader. Other traders added that there was no new fundamental news boosting the stock.
Schering climbed to a record high of 134.90 marks ($86.43), gaining 4.65 percent and then pared gains slightly to stand up 4.50 marks, 3.5 percent, at 133.40 marks after an hour of bourse trade.
Schering has soared since last Tuesday, when the stock stood at 120.20 marks, gaining over ten percent in one week.

Meanwhile the other chemical stocks were lower, pulled down as the dollar weakened. Shares in the export-oriented sector had soared on Tuesday, when the dollar reached 23-month highs above 1.56 marks.
The DAX index of leading shares was also off record highs, down 0.61 percent at 2,869.31 points.
